item.title: Range Rover EV Mirrors Classic Design, 330‑Mile Range
item.description: Land Rover’s upcoming Range Rover Electric retains the iconic silhouette, delivering 330‑mile range, twin 260 kW motors and a 118.5 kWh battery.
